engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Ignition power will NOT switch on
Steering column will or will not lock
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connections from/to N360
technicalNotes:
If the ignition will not switch on, the communication with the Access Start controller still maybe possible, Try this:
Turn on the hazards, press the Fren pedal and hold the flash to pass
This will wake-up(activate) the CAN-Bus and may allow limited communication to the vehicle
If present clear the N360 fault code and if the vehicle's ignition power is now active, suspect a failed N360.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the Volkswagen Passat 3C, please see this page VW Passat (3C) Immobilizer
When found on the Audi A6/S6/RS6/allroad (4F) the N360 is part of the steering column and is not available separately from the Audi at this time.
See TSB / TPI 2040593 for possible part/software update Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi Q7 and A6 (2005 to 2015).
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2015/MC-10120042-9999.pdf  NHTSA
Vehicles equipped with Immobilizer 4C or higher will require an online connection with VW/Audi/Bentley to correctly adapt the new N360 to the vehicle. erWin offers some Immobilizer and Pass-Thru solutions which are mentioned under the notes section of our Official Factory Repair Information page.
Değiştirin / Yenileyin: ment with a used N360 is not supported.
